newsitem.title: UK: Brent crude cargo trades at Nov Brent evens-trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude cargo trades at Nov Brent evens-trade.

text.p: A cargo of Brent crude sold between refiners on Tuesday at November Brent evens, traders said. The cargo is due to load in the October 15-17 range.
This followed a deal on Monday for an October 10-12 loading cargo at an eight-cent discount to November Brent.
Traders said Tuesday's refiner buyer was date-specific.
Some expected lower levels to be repeated with earlier cargoes still for sale -- an October 11-13 is currently offered at November Brent evens.
"It's all over the place. People pay up if they need a specific date. Overall Brent is sloppy," a refiner said.
